messages:
viv.sales: AcmePayments needs a 7-day Dedicated POC. Their infra only allows a handful of outbound IPv4s. Can we give them static egress IPs + a scoped API key?

noah.runtime: Yes. Fastest is Redwood-managed egress attached to the Dedicated instance. We can publish 2 IPv4 /32s for their firewall.

anya.netops: I can reserve the pair once region confirmed. Ask the customer whether their proxy does TLS interception that rewrites certs. If so, we need an on-call tech call.

viv.sales: Region = eu-west-1. They do MITM TLS inspection but agreed to allow raw TCP 443 to our IPs.

sam.sec: Security: require POC intake + signed short DPA before issuing keys. Default log retention = 7 days; bodies redacted. Please collect contact and ACL CIDRs.

quote-bot: Estimated cost for 1 GPU for 7 days: $700-$1,100. Egress add-on prorated: ~$30-$80. Final quote to follow.
